_comment: Navigation of the edition by the objects readers work with (operator's rule 39 of 2026-11-14; four objects since the interface plan of 2026-11-17): one head item per object, and the representations of an object as a switch inside its view. One source for the static pages (build_site) and the interactive views (js/app.js). Paths are relative to the site root; the interactive views live under ansicht/. The Atlas is the start page; `app` is its address inside the views app of the repository, where no start page exists. The former object Orte forwards to the Atlas.
